groups.title: The deals engine — tests/test_iteration59_deals.py
groups.sub: Every workflow of the engine against an in-memory XRP Ledger that answers like the real one (results, refusals, objects).
tests: Create → confirm → agree → pay (two escrows) → picked up (payment leg) → delivered (title leg) → settled.
The escrow fulfillment is stored sealed and never appears in any API document.
tecNO_AUTH is a refused state; CredentialCreate → Accept → MPTokenAuthorize → pay succeeds.
After CancelAfter, EscrowCancel returns both legs; not offered before the date.
A bank transfer stays pending (simulated) and locks the price only when it clears.
Pledge → LoanSet with CollateralID → tecPLEDGED probe; price 80 → top-up; what-if; pay down; repay → release.
The nine seeded deals reproduce the desk of the Figma frames (two need you; 11,000 g in the vault, 10,000 locked).
Fences: a customer runs only their own steps on their own deals; the desk runs every step.
New-deal validation: product, the vault-only bar, quantity, customer.
A customer whose KYC is pending cannot reach the payment step.
The database migration ships a guarded, idempotent SQL twin.
Helper that regenerates the sample data (runs only on request).
The engine's files exist, carry no inline script/style, write HTML only through ui.js.
